record_title: A post-SDPI family of orthogonal relay-channel counterexamples
provenance: Scientific sources, proof evidence, and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem gives a sufficient post-SDPI condition for failure of the proposed three-scheme relay-capacity expression; it does not characterize all failures or upper-bound compress-forward in general. The exact capacity of the orthogonal relay family is prior knowledge. The motivating counterexample preprint is recent, leaving residual near-simultaneous originality risk. No independent validation is asserted.
